lang.description: The language code (e.g., 'en', 'de', 'ru') for the Psi+ user interface.

data_dir.description: Path to the directory where Psi+ stores its local database, logs, and configuration.

use_webkit.description: Whether to use the WebKit engine for rendering chat content, enabling images and animated emoticons.

server.description: The hostname of the XMPP server to connect to by default.

port.description: The TCP port number for the XMPP server connection.

enable_tls.description: Whether to enforce TLS encryption for the connection to the XMPP server.

theme.description: The name of the Adium-style theme to use for the chat interface.

font.description: The default font family for chat messages and UI elements.

font_size.description: The default font size in points.

accounts.description: A list of XMPP account configurations to preload or manage.

accounts.items.description: Configuration for a single XMPP account.

accounts.items.jid.description: The XMPP JID (Jabber ID) for the account (e.g., user@example.com).

accounts.items.password.description: The password for the XMPP account. Note: Storing passwords in config files is generally insecure; consider using keyring.

accounts.items.status.description: The initial presence status when the account connects (e.g., 'available', 'away', 'dnd').

accounts.items.priority.description: The priority level for this account (0-255). Higher priority receives messages first.

enable_otr.description: Enable Off-the-Record (OTR) encryption for private chats.

enable_omemo.description: Enable OMEMO encryption for multi-device secure messaging.

encrypted_only.description: If true, restrict communication to only encrypted channels where possible.
